sources.name: glenngabe
sources.excerpt: Google's Universal Cart finally showed up for me this morning. I started testing it out. Very interesting... So I searched for a few products, clicked "Add to cart", then I had to select the various options and sizes, and then click "Add to cart" again to officially get the item into my cart. Pretty easy to use overall. It leverages Google Pay so it has my payment information already and provides points I can earn for the purchase (based on my credit card). And then a shopping cart icon shows up in Google near my account profile. Clicking that brings up my cart with the items that were added and a separate tab for "My orders". This has a ton of potential, but I'm eager to see how many…
sources.author: @glenngabe
